Class CSGShape

java.lang.Object
net.murat.shape.CSGShape
All Implemented Interfaces:
EMShape
Direct Known Subclasses:
DifferenceCSG, IntersectionCSG, UnionCSG
public abstract class CSGShape extends Object implements EMShape
Abstract base class for Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) operations. Combines two shapes using boolean operations (Union, Intersection, Difference).

COORDINATE CONTRACT. intersectAll(Ray) always returns intervals that are expressed in the frame and the parametrization of the ray it was given:

  • every hit point and normal is already transformed by this CSG's own transform, so a CSG can be nested inside another CSG (or used as a top level shape) without any further conversion;
  • every t value is the parameter of the incoming ray (point = origin + direction * t), even when this CSG carries a scale. Internally the children are queried with a unit length local direction, and the resulting t values are converted back before they are returned.

Note: CSG operations are inherently allocation-heavy due to interval lists. This implementation minimizes allocations but cannot be completely GC-free because child shapes may allocate in their intersectAll() methods.

To make this truly GC-free, child shapes must also be GC-free and this class should use pre-allocated interval pools.

    • intersectAll

      public List<IntersectionInterval> intersectAll(Ray ray)
      Calculates all intersection intervals between a ray and this CSG shape.

      The ray is moved into this shape's local space and handed to both children with a unit length direction. The children's intervals are combined by combine(List, List), and the result is then converted back, so that the returned intervals follow the coordinate contract described in the class documentation: hits are in the caller's frame and t values are in the caller's ray parametrization.

      Note: This method allocates (new ray, new result list, new hit copies) and may also allocate if child shapes allocate in their intersectAll() implementations.

      Specified by:
      intersectAll in interface EMShape
      Parameters:
      ray - The ray to test, in the caller's coordinates
      Returns:
      A list of IntersectionInterval objects, never null

    • combine

      protected abstract List<IntersectionInterval> combine(List<IntersectionInterval> a, List<IntersectionInterval> b)
      Combines two lists of intersection intervals according to the CSG operation. Subclasses implement this for Union, Intersection, and Difference. Both lists are in this shape's local space; the base class converts the result afterwards.
      Parameters:
      a - Intervals from left shape
      b - Intervals from right shape
      Returns:
      Combined intervals

    • intersect

      public boolean intersect(Ray ray, Intersection hit)
      Intersects a ray with this CSG shape and reports the nearest boundary of the solid in front of the ray origin. If the origin is inside the solid, the nearest boundary is the exit surface.
      Specified by:
      intersect in interface EMShape
      Parameters:
      ray - The ray to intersect
      hit - The Intersection object to store hit information
      Returns:
      true if intersection occurs, false otherwise

    • refreshChildMaterials

      public void refreshChildMaterials()
      Procedural materials evaluate in object space. For a child inside a CSG the object point is: childInverse * csgInverse * worldPoint. Runs whenever the CSG transform or a child material changes (including every animation frame, via setTransform).

    • toObjString

      public String toObjString()
      Generates an OBJ format string representation of this CSGShape. Transform is applied directly to vertices, not written as OBJ transform. Uses robust vertex deduplication with tolerance to avoid degenerate triangles.
      Specified by:
      toObjString in interface EMShape
      Returns:
